name: In Memoriam
summary: Sister Rowland asks you to relight memorial candles at Farholde Keep. The small act honors the dead and helps keep the church alive.

sections.title: Candles for the Fallen
sections.body: At Farholde Keep, Sister Rowland asks you to tend the chapel graveyard. Place fresh candles on three graves where the old flames have gone out, and give the fallen a quiet remembrance.

faq.q: Who asks me to light the candles?
faq.answer: Sister Rowland at Farholde Keep asks you to light memorial candles in the chapel graveyard.
Place the memorial candles on graves in the chapel graveyard at Farholde Keep.
Sister Rowland asks you to place three memorial candles on graves.
The candles honor those who have died and help keep the church alive.
